d: Holland is hosting 12 different countries with 14 of the strongest men in the world for the third stage of the Strongman Champions League.
Zydrunas Savickas, one of strongest people on earth is in this competition which has attracted the attention of the audience in the battle for the title of strongest man in Finland.
The next stage of the competition is in Bulgaria where Ervin Katona (SCL World Champion 2012) will compete for the last time.
Hall of Famer Dirk Nowitzki revolutionized basketball with unprecedented shooting as a seven-footer. An NBA champion and MVP, he forever changed how the modern power forward is played.
Austin Cindric became the first rookie to win the Daytona 500 and earned NASCAR Cup Series Rookie of the Year honors in 2022. The former Xfinity champion continues to add Cup victories to his résumé.
